newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint steady vs dlr, BCE yen futures main movers.
newsitem.headline: Forint steady vs dlr, BCE yen futures main movers.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed unchanged against the dollar but remained some 50 pips weaker than the central bank's resistance level (bid), dealers said on Friday.
"Many traders are banking on a strengthening of the dollar," said Istvan Hideg of Takarekbank.
The forint finished at 158.15/20 against the dollar compared with its opening of 158.10/20.
Dealers added they expect the forint to remain weaker than the central bank's resistance level for most of December.
In the currency section of Budapest Commodity Exchange, yen futures were the main movers, dropping for four maturities.
Swiss franc futures also ended lower for three maturities.
Total turnover was 2.09 billion forints or 12,638 contracts, of which 4,000 contracts were for the Italian lira.
